expectedIssues: Restaurant cover image failed to load
reportedIssues: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in 'Popular right now' shows no photo — only a blank light-grey block with a broken-image icon, unlike every other restaurant card which has artwork.

Because the image is missing, the favourite (heart) button on the Tokumaru card renders as a grey circle with a white outline on a near-identical light grey background, giving very low contrast compared with the dark heart button on the pizza card below.
The empty image container on the Tokumaru card is quite tall relative to its now-empty content, creating a large stretch of dead grey space that visually breaks the rhythm of the list.
